intent: Presentational standalone OnPush 4-stage chevron timeline. Public API exactly: ChevronStepperComponent selector app-chevron-stepper { phases = input.required<readonly PhaseProgress[]>(); state = input<ViewState>('success'); activePhaseId = input<string | null>(null); phaseSelected = output<string>() }. Imports PhaseProgress (shared/models/phase-progress.model.ts) and ViewState (shared/models/view-state.model.ts). Renders states loading|empty|error|success; active chevron = activePhaseId or the IN_PROGRESS phase. Imported by dashboard and routines (shared per Rule 1 cond. 3).
